boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Creates a circle of radius %d at your feet; the circle protects you from silence effects while you remain in its radius while silencing and dealing %d light damage to everyone else who enters. The circle lasts %d turns.
entries.target:
在你的脚下制造一个 %d 码半径范围的法阵，当你在法阵内，它会使你免疫沉默效果，并沉默进入此范围的其他所有生物，对其造成 %d 光系伤害。
		法阵持续 %d 回合。

entries.source: Losgoroth are mighty void elementals, native to the void between the stars. They are rarely seen on a planet's surface.
entries.target: 洛斯格罗斯是强大的虚空生物，居住于群星之间的星空中。在星球表面几乎看不到这种生物。

entries.source: I have already found such a chest in my travel. Will it work?
entries.target: 我在旅途中已经找到过一个这样的转化之盒。它能用吗？
#LIGHT_BLUE# * -2 力量，+1 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.source:
Instill a part of your living curse into a weapon in your inventory, and toss it nearby. This nearly impervious sentry will attack all nearby enemies for %d turns. When the curse ends, the weapon will drop to the ground.
			Cursed Sentry attack speed (currently %d%%) will improve with talent level.
			When you first select a weapon, it will be remembered and used as long as it's in your inventory. Use Choose Cursed Sentry talent to alter your selection.
			At talent level 3, you get the ability to afflict powerful mundane objects (greater egos).
			At talent level 5, you can corrupt artifacts.
entries.target:
将你身上的一部分活性诅咒灌注到物品栏的一件武器中，并把它投向附近。这个近乎坚不可摧的诅咒护卫会攻击附近所有敌人，持续 %d 回合。诅咒结束时，武器会掉落在地面上。
		诅咒护卫的攻击速度随技能等级提高（当前 %d%%）。
		首次选择武器后，只要它仍在物品栏中，就会被记住并继续使用。使用“选择诅咒护卫”技能可更改选择。
		技能等级达到 3 时，你可以将带有高级词缀的强力普通武器化为护卫。
		技能等级达到 5 时，你可以将神器化为护卫。

entries.source: Your deep link with Nature allows you to reset the cooldown of %d of your wild gifts of tier %d or less.
entries.target: 你与大自然间的深刻联系，使你能够立刻冷却 %d 个技能层次不超过 %d 的自然系技能。

entries.source:
You conceal spring loaded blades within your equipment. On scoring a critical strike, you follow up with your blades for %d%% damage (as an unarmed attack).
This talent has a cooldown.
#YELLOW#Prepared with: %s#LAST#
entries.target:
你将刀片隐藏在装备中，当你对临近目标造成暴击时，刀片自动弹出，造成 %d%% 徒手武器伤害。
该技能有冷却时间。
#YELLOW#已装填：%s#LAST#
#LIGHT_BLUE# * -3 力量，-2 敏捷，-5 体质

entries.source: Tinker will be attached to a worn object
entries.target: 插件将会被插到一个穿戴的物品上。

entries.source: Enter a state of heightened focus for %d turns. While in this state your ranged attack speed is increased by %d%%, your shots do not consume ammo, and all shots capable of marking have their chance to mark increased by %d%%.
entries.target: 进入专注状态 %d 回合，远程攻击速度增加 %d%%，射击不消耗弹药，标记概率增加 %d%%。

entries.source: "Won" ToME by sacrificing yourself for your patron Distant Sun, opening a portal for it to burn and consume the world.
entries.target: 以牺牲自己，为遥远的太阳打开传送门，灼烧并毁灭整个世界的方式，"通关"ToME。

entries.source: The Maze is west of Derth.

#GOLD#Armour Hardiness#LAST#
Armour hardiness represents how much of each incoming blows the armour will affect.
Absorbs (hardiness)% of incoming weapon damage, up to a maximum of (armour) damage absorbed.
entries.target:
#GOLD#护甲强度#LAST#
护甲强度表示护甲可以减免的伤害百分比。
护甲吸收（护甲强度）%武器伤害，但最多吸收相当于护甲值的伤害。

entries.source:
Hits the target with your weapon, doing %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target's armour and saves are reduced by %d for %d turns.
		Also if the target is protected by any temporary magical or psionic damage absorbing shields there is %d%% chance to shatter one random shield.
		Armor reduction chance increases with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
用武器攻击目标，造成 %d%% 伤害。若攻击命中，目标的护甲和所有豁免降低 %d 点，持续 %d 回合。
		如果目标受到临时的魔法或灵能伤害吸收护盾保护，还有 %d%% 几率随机击碎其中一个护盾。
		护甲削减的成功几率受物理强度加成。

entries.source:
Your expertise in the art of energy projection grows.
		Aura cooldowns are all reduced by %d turns. Aura damage drains energy more slowly (+%0.2f damage required to lose a point of energy).
entries.target:
你增加了在灵能值运用方面的知识。
		所有光环的冷却时间减少 %d 回合。光环消耗灵能值变的更慢（消耗每点灵能值所需伤害值 +%0.2f）。

entries.source: The target is waiting to be recalled back to Angolwen.
entries.target: 目标等待被传送至安格利文。

entries.source: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
entries.target: 一个掌握刺杀和潜行的兽人刺客。

entries.source: a summoned wall of mental energy
entries.target: 一堵被召唤来的精神能量墙。

entries.source:
While in deeprock form, you become indomitable, granting you %d%% resistance to cuts, poisons, diseases and stuns.
		At level 5 and higher, while Deeprock Form is active, all incoming damage is applied against physical resistance instead of the normal resistance type.
entries.target:
当你进入深岩元素形态时，你获得 %d%% 流血、毒素、疾病和震慑免疫。
		技能等级 5 或以上时，在深岩元素形态下，你将用物理抗性取代其他伤害抗性。

entries.source: Object held in your telekinetic grasp. It can be a weapon or some other item to provide a benefit to your psionic powers.
entries.target: 使用你的念动力抓取的物品。你可以抓取武器，或者抓取其他物品来为你的心灵力量提供增益。

entries.source: Saved Melinda again and invited her to the Fortress to cure her.
entries.target: 再次拯救梅琳达，并邀请她到堡垒去治愈她。

entries.source: This jeweled crown shimmers with colors.
entries.target: 这顶镶嵌宝石的王冠闪闪发光。

entries.source: Removes up to %d detrimental magical effects and empowers you with arcane energy for ten turns, increasing spellpower and spell save by 5 plus 5 per effect removed.
entries.target: 最多移除 %d 个负面魔法效果，并以奥术能量强化你 10 回合，使法术强度和法术豁免提高 5 点；每移除一个负面魔法效果，二者再提高 5 点。

entries.source: Inflict maximum pain to specific places on your enemies.
entries.target: 向指定位置射出弹药造成大量伤害。

entries.source:
Good. Before your... untimely arrival we were preparing an attack on the Ziguranth main training camp, on the southern beach of the sea of Sash.
Come with us; let's destroy them!
I will open a portal to Zigur and the massacre shall begin!
entries.target:
很好。在你这……不合时宜的造访之前，我们正准备进攻位于萨希之海南岸的伊格兰斯主要训练营地。
跟我们来，让我们彻底消灭他们！
我将开启通往伊格的传送门，屠杀即将开始！

entries.source: This robe was formerly owned by Callister the Psion, a powerful Psionic that pioneered many Psionic abilities. After his wife was murdered, Callister became obsessed with finding her killer, using his own hatred as a fuel for new and disturbing arts. After forcing the killer to torture himself to death, Callister walked the land, forcing any he found to kill themselves - his way of releasing them from the world's horrors. One day, he simply disappeared. This robe, soaked in blood, was the only thing he left behind.
entries.target: 这件长袍曾被灵能者卡利斯特拥有，他是一名强大的灵能者，开创了许多灵能能力。在他的妻子被谋杀之后，卡利斯特执着于寻找凶手，用自己的仇恨作为燃料，创造了令人不安的技术。让杀手折磨自己致死后，他行走在地上，迫使任何他发现的人自杀——这是他从世界的恐怖中给予人解脱的方式。有一天，他消失了。这浸泡在血液中的长袍，是他留下的唯一物品。

entries.source: #GREY#The #Source# looks deep into your eyes. You feel torn apart!
entries.target: #GREY##Source#凝视着你的眼睛。你感觉你被撕裂了！

entries.source: purge up to %d diseases (based on Willpower) and gain disease immunity, %d%% blight resistance, and %d spell save for 5 turns
entries.target: 除去至多 %d 项疾病（基于意志），并获得疾病免疫、%d%% 枯萎抗性和 %d 法术豁免，持续 5 回合。
通用 物理暴击伤害

entries.source: All physical criticals reduce the remaining cooldown of a random technique or cunning talent by 2.
entries.target: 所有的物理暴击减少随机的 1 个冷却中的格斗或灵巧系技能 2 回合冷却时间。

entries.source: You cannot use Thread the Needle without an appropriate weapon!
entries.target: 你需要装备合适的武器来使用该技能
